description: Give an AI agent its own blockchain wallet: balances, USDC transfers, x402 payments under policy.
name: io.keyban.prod.mcp/agent-wallet

environmentVariables.description: Keyban API key of the application the wallet belongs to. Never exposed to the model.
environmentVariables.name: KEYBAN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: One-shot ECDSA private key (0x + 64 hex) authorizing the first-boot registration of this client as a FROST signer of the wallet.
environmentVariables.name: KEYBAN_INVITE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Address of the deployed SchnorrAccount this server drives (0x + 40 hex).
environmentVariables.name: KEYBAN_WALLET_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: Blockchain network the wallet operates on, for example base or xdc.
environmentVariables.name: KEYBAN_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Keyban backend. Accepts a full URL, or one of the environment aliases dev, testing, staging, prod and sandbox.
environmentVariables.name: KEYBAN_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional pre-generated FROST client share, base64-encoded JSON. Used by hosted runtimes with no OS keyring; it does not replace the invite key.
environmentVariables.name: KEYBAN_DKG_BLOB

environmentVariables.description: Path the server writes its log to.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_FILE

title: Keyban Agent Wallet
